request: Inspect healthy staged receiver and live receiver before controlled cutover

bounded_host_request.command: set -e; for n in server-core-bounded-host server-core-bounded-host-stage-96d01bb; do docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.Name}}|{{.State.Status}}|{{.Config.Image}}|{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$k}} {{end}}' || exit 1; done; systemctl is-active gace-servercore-service-deploy.service gace-servercore-result-sink.service || true
